subject.title: Improve doctor/gateway diagnostics clarity for mixed LaunchAgent/runtime states

question: What final doctor diagnosis taxonomy and recovery order should OpenClaw standardize for mixed LaunchAgent, runtime, RPC, service-drift, and channel-conflict states?
rationale: Current code has the raw facts but the remaining behavior is a product-facing operator diagnosis contract, not a narrow broken-line fix.

options.title: Compose final doctor verdict
options.body: Add a final healthy/degraded/down-style verdict that reuses existing checks and prints deterministic recovery steps for each mixed state.

options.title: Patch only confusing messages after live proof
options.body: Keep independent doctor panels for now and wait for a captured macOS recovery transcript before changing the output contract.

options.title: Specify JSON diagnosis first
options.body: Design the machine-readable diagnosis schema before changing human output, accepting a broader CLI contract decision up front.

recommendation.title: Compose final doctor verdict
recommendation.body: Add a final healthy/degraded/down-style verdict that reuses existing checks and prints deterministic recovery steps for each mixed state.

likelyOwner.reason: The most relevant current-main history for doctor/gateway repair flow points to steipete, and this decision primarily affects that surface.
